concept.title: BRUTALIST TIDE
concept.description: A 15-second kinetic art piece. A Hawaiian woman moves through a stark brutalist concrete void. Camera is violent and mechanical: sudden arcs, robotic arm swings and hard cuts in framing every 1.5 seconds. Minimalist but brutal.

identity.hair: Long thick black hair, slightly wet, heavy and natural
identity.face: Strong Polynesian features, calm intense gaze.
identity.clothing: Simple black fabric wrapped around the body like a minimalist pareo

camera_direction.camera_journey: Robotic arm and sudden arcs dominate. Every 1.5 seconds the camera snaps, swings or orbits hard. Extreme low angles, overhead drops, whip-pans and locked mechanical holds. The camera itself feels like a brutalist machine.

color_palette: Single accent of burnt hibiscus orange
visual_style.materials_and_texture: Matte concrete, wet black fabric, hard directional light, sharp shadows, no softness

motion_language.kick: Hard camera snap or robotic swing
motion_language.sub_bass: Slow heavy body movement of the woman

beats.description: Extreme low angle. Woman stands still in a vast concrete chamber. Hard side light.
Robotic arm swings 90 degrees. She takes one heavy step forward.
Sudden overhead drop. Hair and fabric react with weight.
Violent arc around her body. She turns slowly against the camera force.
Hard push-in to her face. Eyes locked, no emotion.
Camera snaps to side profile. She raises one arm with deliberate strength.
Robotic crane rises fast. She becomes small against the brutalist architecture.
Whip pan into a tight torso shot. Fabric stretches and folds.
Sudden reverse angle. She looks directly into the lens.
Final mechanical hold. Wide shot. She stands centered, still under a single hard light.
